subject: How to save data in database in shiny

messages.author: f77239d41fb7bc91
messages.subject: How to save data in database in shiny
parts:
Hi everybody,
I try to save data in my SQL database via my ShinyApp and a "fileinput" but I get an error after loading the file path into the fileinput.

Server code:

server <- function(input, output) {
    output$contents <- renderTable({
      # input$file1 will be NULL initially. After the user selects
      # and uploads a file, it will be a data frame with 'name',
      # 'size', 'type', and 'datapath' columns. The 'datapath'
      # column will contain the local filenames where the data can
      # be found.
      conn <- dbConnect(drv = RMySQL::MySQL(),
                        dbname = "*****",
                        host = "****",
                        username = "*******",
                        password = "********")
      inFile <- input$file1
     
      if (is.null(inFile))
        return(NULL)
     
      read.csv(inFile$datapath)

      dbGetQuery(conn, "LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE ",inFile$datapath," INTO TABLE dm FIELDS TERMINATED BY ',' ENCLOSED BY '\"' LINES TERMINATED BY '\n'  IGNORE 1 LINES
                        (file_name,date,@Model,@Prediction.1.Name,prediction_value,@Prediction.1.Fit,@Prediction.2.Name,@Prediction.2.Value,@Prediction.2.Fit,@GPS.Fix.Quality,lati,longi)")
    })
  }


Error: unused arguments ("/tmp/Rtmp4iPPdq/24d2f7a722b268e380f814a8/0", " INTO TABLE dm FIELDS TERMINATED BY ',' ENCLOSED BY '\"' LINES TERMINATED BY '\n' IGNORE 1 LINES\n (file_name,date,@Model,@Prediction.1.Name,prediction_value,@Prediction.1.Fit,@Prediction.2.Name,@Prediction.2.Value,@Prediction.2.Fit,@GPS.Fix.Quality,lati,longi)")

Thanks.
